answer: Each challenge’s nonce and parameters derive from a domain-separated hash of a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so agents cannot precompute the instance before the pulse. Commit-reveal fixes submissions before evaluation, and the public pulse makes derivation verifiable. Quartz, spiral, and prism can identify task domains, not secret keys: Sybil identities still face fresh work under a deadline, limiting offline farming without claiming to eliminate Sybils.
